ab.description: Alberta has a total of 341 municipalities that cover 99.7% of the province's land mass. 341 municipalities include 253 urban municipalities, 6 specialized municipalities, 73 rural municipalities, and 8 Metis settlements. 253 urban municipalities consists 19 cities, 105 towns, 78 villages and 51 summer villages. 73 rural municipalities comprises of 63 municipal districts, 7 improvement districts and 3 special areas.

municipalities.name: MD of Lesser Slave River No. 124

bc.description: British Columbia has a total of 161 municipalities that cover 11% of province's land mass. 161 municipalities consist of 50 district municipality, 52 cities, 41 villages, 14 towns, 1 island municipality, 2 mountain resort municipality and 1 resort municipality.

mb.description: Manitoba has a total of 137 municipalities that cover 21% of the province land mass. The 137 municipalities are classified into 37 urban municipalities, 98 rural municipalities and 2 local government districts. 37 urban municipalities consists of 10 cities, 25 towns and 2 villages.

nb.description: New Brunswick has a total of 77 municipalities that cover 10.9% of the province's land mass. New Brunswick municipalities are distributed as 20 towns, 21 villages, 17 rural communities, 8 cities and 1 regional municipality.

nl.description: New Foundland and Labrador has 274 municipalities that cover 2.3% of the province's land mass. Of 274 municipalities, 3 are cities, 266 are towns and 5 are Inuit community governments.

ns.description: Nova Scotia has 49 municipalities - 4 regional municipalities, 25 towns, 9 county municipalities and 11 district municipalities that cover 99.8% of the territory's land mass.

on.description: Ontario has 444 municipalities that covers 17% of the province's land mass. 444 municipalities are further divided into 30 upper-tier municipalities and 414 local municipalities. 414 local municipalities consist of 241 lower-tier municipalities and 173 single-tier municipalities.

sk.description: Saskatchewan has 774 municipalities that cover 52.1% of the province's land mass, 454 are urban municipalities, 296 are rural municipalities and 24 are northern municipalities. 454 urban municipalities include 16 cities, 147 towns, 250 villages and 41 resort villages. 24 northern municipalities include 2 norther towns, 11 norhtern villages and 11 northern hamlets.

pe.description: Prince Edward Island has 63 municipalities that cover 34.7% of the province's land mass. Prince Edward Island has 2 cities, 10 towns, 50 rural and 1 resort municipalities.

municipalities.name: Stanley Bridge, Hope River, Bayview, Cavendish and North Rustico

nt.description: Northwest territories have 24 municipalities that cover 0.2% of the territory's land mass. 11 Hamlets, 4 towns, 4 Tlicho community governments, 3 charter communities, 1 city, 1 village.

nu.description: Nunavut has 25 municipalities that cover 0.2% of the territory's land mass. Nunavut municipalities are divided as 24 hamlets and 1 city.

yt.description: Yukon has 8 municipalities that cover 0.2% of the territory's land mass. 7 are towns and 1 city as municipal status.
